query:
SELECT
                pk_systems.uuid,
                pk_systems.id AS "id: PluralKitId<SystemMarker>",
                pk_systems.name,
                pk_systems.avatar,
                pk_systems.created_at,
                pk_systems.updated_at
            FROM
                pk_systems
            LEFT JOIN
                pk_system_fronters
            ON pk_systems.uuid = pk_system_fronters.system_uuid
            WHERE
                (
                    pk_system_fronters.updated_at IS NULL
                    OR pk_system_fronters.updated_at <= NOW() - interval '1 minutes'
                )
                AND uuid IN (
                    SELECT
                        uuid
                    FROM
                        pk_tracked_systems
                )
            ORDER BY
                pk_system_fronters.updated_at
            ASC NULLS FIRST
            LIMIT 5
